description: On-chain forecasting polls on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30): users submit lower/upper estimates and the program records the crowd's midpoint and uncertainty. Sol.College runs this lab on its own fork.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/poe-solana fork. The upstream author (ProofOfEstimate) has not joined Sol.College and there is no partnership; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College's own reviewer, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_poll, register_user, make_estimate, resolve_poll)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet app at sol.college/dapps/poe-solana/
QA: localnet fixtures and negative cases
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: make_estimate with lower > upper aborts with a u16 underflow instead of a clear InvalidBounds error
